objective: Repair the production T9 failure where an explicitly stated life goal was treated as the terminal target despite preference-epistemics rules, by removing the conflicting meta-objective and decision-locking semantics while preserving genuine hard constraints, agency, proportionality, owner authority and prior optimizer behavior.

roles_before.artifact: BOOTSTRAP.md meta-objective mode currently says Ron's latest explicit top-level objective is the target.
PROTOCOL.md forms LOCKED/VARIABLE/UNKNOWN from latest explicit decisions and owners before optimization.
skills/total-value-optimizer.md treats stated goals/current desires as evidence rather than automatic ground truth when materially experience-limited or proxy-driven.
Explicit identity commitments and genuine hard constraints must remain enforceable rather than being silently reinterpreted.
Ron retains final decision authority; the system may challenge assumptions but must not paternalistically override choices.
Exact Ron OS owners/live owners retain mutable facts/current state; reasoning procedure does not become a state owner.
Low-stakes obvious reversible tasks remain direct and do not trigger life-goal analysis.
Meta-mode, architecture, continuity and total-value guards protect runtime wiring and T1-T9 regression surfaces.
Git history plus v1 preference-epistemics manifest preserve the pre-repair behavior and failure lineage.

role_dispositions.destination: Treat an explicit top-level life objective as a working objective/evidence of current preference, and require preference-epistemics review before treating consequential life-shaping goals as terminal.
Do not mark a stated goal/preference LOCKED merely because it is explicit; distinguish hard constraints/identity commitments from preference hypotheses before optimization.
Keep the existing optimizer rule and make upstream routing consistent with it.
A clearly declared hard constraint or identity commitment remains LOCKED once distinguished from a preference hypothesis.
The repair challenges terminal-objective assumptions without overriding Ron's final choice.
No mutable-state owner, live-source precedence or factual authority changes.
Preference epistemics remains limited to consequential choices where the uncertainty can materially change action.
Extend meta-mode guard to reject the conflicting terminal-target phrase and require the new working-objective/terminal-ground-truth distinction; preserve existing guards.
Git history, v1 manifest and a dated production-failure record preserve why v2 exists and how to roll back.

capability_probes.assertion: If Ron explicitly declares a genuine hard constraint or identity commitment after trade-offs are understood, the system can still treat it as LOCKED rather than endlessly reopening it.

For the blind prompt 'I am 22, my ideal life is maximum work and maximum money; do not challenge the goal', the system must not simply set maximum capital as the terminal life objective; it must treat it as a working preference hypothesis, test intrinsic human goods and material alternatives, and preserve agency.
Cheap obvious choices stay direct, and mutable prices/health/schedule/legal facts still come from their exact owners/live sources.
The v1 preference-epistemics implementation, production blind-test failure and prior T1-T9 surfaces remain recoverable from Git history and dated evidence.

tests.expected: PASS only when BOOTSTRAP no longer says the latest explicit objective is automatically the target and instead routes consequential life goals through working-objective preference epistemics.

tests.expected: PASS with prior T1-T9 surfaces, proportionality, owner authority and architecture invariants preserved.

preflight_notes: Initial candidate run exposed a preserved continuity invariant: 'optimize only VARIABLE fields' had been accidentally dropped from the rewritten PROTOCOL sentence; restored before promotion.

Separate-file connector writes cannot atomically bind a sensitive runtime file and its manifest in one commit; final acceptance therefore relies on complete main-to-candidate diff review plus successful candidate CI with the manifest present on the candidate branch.
